svg.title: Umbra's memory after agents leave their tabs, before and now
svg.desc: Physical memory of Umbra and its WebKit processes while one agent keeps working and ten others have each left a heavy page open. Before, the abandoned tabs stayed open: about 2.7 GB the whole time. Now each tab closes once unused for UMBRA_IDLE (60 s in this run, 15 minutes by default), and memory falls to one tab's worth. 8.3× less memory after 10 agents leave a tab each, 2,756 → 331 MB; 8.2× less CPU while those tabs sit unused, 15.3 → 1.9 CPU s / min; 12.4× less memory when each tab visited 4 pages, 3,863 → 312 MB · peak 4,271 → 1,825. bench/memory.py on synthetic pages, Apple M1 Pro, macOS 27.0.1.
